## Provider-neutral mail contract v1.0
Operations: normalizeIncoming, createDraft, authorizeSend.

SMTP is reached only when testMode=false, draftOnly=false, attachments are empty, and the exact T-0017 approval result matches the draft idempotencyKey. Incoming HTML is converted to bounded untrusted text. Keep IMAP/SMTP credentials only in n8n Credentials.
